inspiration.observed_pattern: JSON_TABLE exposes a JSON payload column that can be passed to JSON_QUERY for nested object extraction.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored catalog row with one nested object fragment, retaining JSON_TABLE JSON-column materialization and JSON_QUERY shape extraction while removing the second row and array projection.

fixture_notes: One fixed catalog payload exposes a nested details object through JSON_TABLE and JSON_QUERY.
determinism_notes: One literal JSON object and one ordered result row; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT jt.item_id, JSON_QUERY(jt.attributes, '$.details') AS details_fragment, JSON_TYPE(JSON_QUERY(jt.attributes, '$.details')) AS details_type FROM JSON_TABLE('[{"id":91,"attributes":{"details":{"tier":"silver"}}}]', '$[*]' COLUMNS (item_id INT PATH '$.id', attributes JSON PATH '$.attributes')) AS jt ORDER BY jt.item_id
